title: Can Vision-Language Models Count? A Synthetic Benchmark and Analysis of Attention-Based Interventions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model counting accuracy and Mean Relative Count Error (MRCE) on a synthetic dataset by systematically varying visual properties (object color, shape, texture, background color, and background texture) and prompt specificity. This measures the model's reliance on inherent, memorized language priors or training patterns rather than genuinely analyzing the visual features to count objects.
